source_drift.required_main_text_mismatch: halt current case and all remaining cases; no replay or adaptive scheduling
source_drift.raw_only_mismatch: record, continue if extracted main content unchanged
source_drift.when: every candidate fetch matching frozen required source or canonical mirror

bootstrap_unit: whole task, retaining repetitions and configurations

evidence_schema.request_usage: summary with raw_steps containing unmodified native usage; native_usage is also retained
evidence_schema.usage_complete: all count totals/subsets known; reported cost may remain null; totals_complete, subsets_complete and known_fields separately disclose completeness
evidence_schema.uncached_input_tokens: nonoverlapping prompt residual after cache-read and cache-write subsets; null if a subset is unknown, unless native cache-miss count explicitly resolves it; never add subsets to native inclusive input/output
evidence_schema.post_ledger: execution/post-starts.jsonl; fsynced before each actual client POST boundary, including ambiguous transmission failures; request intent_utc precedes started_utc
evidence_schema.history: history_path; native assistant messages and exact JSON tool-result envelopes, additionally linked by fetch tool_result_path/hash
evidence_schema.fetch_status: ok/rejected/http_error/fetch_error/interrupted plus separate native http_status; redirects retain from/to/status
evidence_schema.source_match: frozen_source_match has raw/text booleans; shared whole-page extraction hashes include substantive semantic callouts, not navigation sidebars
evidence_schema.terminal_cases: all saved terminal rows including honest unrun; attempted_terminal_cases separately counts attempted terminal cases
evidence_schema.cleanup: per-case and aggregate owned-only process checks, exact supplied-key scans and frozen-input checks; external_state_unchanged means runner write-boundary compliance, not a global filesystem snapshot
evidence_schema.blind_index_cases: opaque blind IDs; paths are derivable as blind/cases/<ID>/case.json
evidence_schema.blind_sources: fetched versus frozen_reference; candidate_visible_path identifies the exact preview when truncated; frozen references never count as candidate fetches or cited support
evidence_schema.blind_mapping: private mapping ID to case-ID string and sealed_hashes path to SHA256; no unblinded_utc until later parent-owned unblinding
evidence_schema.blind_redactions: private/redactions.json answer operations with original/replacement/reason:self_identification; first-party source text is not rewritten

qualification.citations: entailing for all substantive claims; full HTTPS URLs; supplied anchors must exist

quantiles.median: sorted middle, average for even n

visible_word_rule: all assistant content turns; remove Markdown link destinations and bare HTTPS URLs, remove Markdown marker characters; whitespace-delimited visible tokens; do not exclude code or commentary; reasoning/tool text excluded

timing.wall_s: supervisor monotonic immediately before worker launch through drained exit
timing.assistant_span_s: first client POST start to last response/error finish; includes intervening fetches

harness_difference: standard-library direct nonstreaming Go POST; no OpenCode CLI/server/ambient config/tools/title/compaction; candidate sees only fixed system, task and one webfetch schema; harness worker is not an OS filesystem sandbox but model has no filesystem interface
wire_evidence: sanitized outbound bodies, native responses/usage, and durable request intent before each client POST; steps are not physical provider HTTP attempts

security.credentials: ephemeral GO_API_KEY only at approved execute; no store access
security.dns: all resolved addresses public; connect pinned first address with hostname TLS verification
security.allowed_urls: task-scoped exact hosts/path regexes in webfetch.ALLOWLIST; no credentials/nonstandard ports
security.process_cleanup: kill and await only newly-owned worker process group; drain output; verify group gone
